outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Asset type: STYLE A approval sheet for the large art-consistency revision of the existing Russian farming RPG "Лунная долина". Input: actual supply-cabinet screenshot is the reference for the warm handcrafted game art and the current mix of flat placeholders and detailed food icons. Generate a single wide landscape 4 by 4 grid of 16 redesigned ITEM ICONS on warm pale parchment, with equal clean cells and small legible Russian captions BELOW each icon, not written into the icon. Top heading exactly "A · Чистые силуэты". These are design concepts, not a finished runtime atlas.
Style A: appealing detailed hand-painted game inventory icons with smooth clean contours, warm restrained dark outlines, strong silhouettes readable at 32–44 pixels, broad meaningful highlights, enough material shading to distinguish glass, pottery, herbs and wood. Match the charm of the existing bread and omelet icons, with less pixel noise. No flat vector placeholders, no hard one-pixel stair-step edges, no photorealistic 3D rendering, no excessive tiny markings, no decorative lunar ornament on everything. No baked cast shadows; only material self-shading. Props with straight structural edges face the screen squarely instead of rotated 45 degrees.
Row 1, left to right: fresh field mint bundle "Мята" (distinct serrated green leaves); glowing pale blue curved moongrass tuft "Лунная трава" (restrained glow); juniper twig with blue berries "Можжевельник"; honey-brown spore mushroom cap cluster "Спорник".
Row 2: tied dried mint bundle "Сушёная мята", recognizably dry not a recolored fresh leaf; open small paper packet of pale blue crushed herb powder "Лунный порошок"; short round corked glass flask with dark blue berry juice "Сок можжевельника"; narrow amber corked tincture vial with a root emblem/twine, no text on bottle "Настойка корня". Give these four forms unmistakably different silhouettes, not just color.
Row 3: empty clear slender glass vial "Флакон"; short wide transparent solvent flask with light fluid "Растворитель"; taller green-tinted empty glass bottle with a sturdy base "Стеклянная бутыль"; stout terracotta cooking/storage pot with rim and small handles "Горшок".
Row 4: short straight rectangular timber beam with visible end grain "Брус"; small pile and paper scoop of golden sawdust "Опилки"; rough gray mineral chunks containing visible iron flecks "Железная руда"; mixed bent iron offcuts, a nail and small broken bracket "Металлолом".
All 16 fully visible, coherent lighting and brush treatment, balanced spacing, no random extra items. Preserve each subject's actual semantic meaning. Readable captions and graphic hierarchy. Color cannot be the only difference between similar materials. This is a review sheet that will later be generated/sliced into transparent individual assets after user selection.

Same exact 16 subjects and order, do not invent extra objects:

Row 4: rectangular timber beam with grain and end rings "Брус"; pile/scoop of golden sawdust "Опилки"; rough gray chunks with iron flecks "Железная руда"; bent rusty metal offcuts, nail and bracket "Металлолом".

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: furniture direction and scale approval sheet for the comprehensive visual polish of "Лунная долина".
Input images are the existing rustic table, wooden chair, bench, home chest and wardrobe, in that order. Retain their brown wood/brass rustic farming-game identity, but remove the current unwanted diagonal three-quarter perspective and magenta fringe from the chest. This is a REVIEW SHEET, not a finished transparent atlas.
Create a crisp 5-row by 4-column sprite comparison on pale neutral parchment. Column headers, exact Cyrillic: "ВНИЗ", "ВЛЕВО", "ВВЕРХ", "ВПРАВО". Rows, top to bottom: table, chair, bench, chest, wardrobe. Small row labels outside the art: "Стол", "Стул", "Лавочка", "Сундук", "Шкаф".
All twenty isolated sprites fully visible in equal spacious cells, common lower-centre ground anchor within each cell. Keep sensible relative scale: wardrobe tallest, chair lower, table and bench waist height, chest low. Identical size/density for the same object across its four directions. Hand-painted friendly game art with clean broad shading and enough wood grain; refined readable contours at 72–120 game pixels, avoid coarse pixel noise and photorealism.
ALL VIEWS use a fixed overhead RPG camera and screen-aligned orthographic structural edges, no 45-degree/isometric or three-quarter views, no diagonal legs or rhombus bases, no rotating a finished image flat onto its side. A thin top surface can be visible, but its front edge is horizontal and its side edges vertical.
South/down shows the front. West/left and east/right show real narrow side profiles, still standing upright. North/up shows the back. Chair backrest and seat placement must clearly indicate the facing direction; chest's brass lock exists only on its front, not on its back. Wardrobe handles exist only on the two frontal doors; back shows plain vertical boards/braces. Symmetrical table geometry can repeat between front/back without inventing a drawer or service attachment. Bench must have the same structure across all directions with the backrest visible from the proper side.
No extra props, no characters, no green screens, no visible cast shadows baked into sprites. Subtle grounding only on the review background. Do not enlarge all objects to the same height. This sheet demonstrates a reusable direction system; final isolated game assets would be created after approval.
